description: [Acquire · 1 credit] Fetch one LinkedIn company (numeric id, name, industry, size, location, website, description). Costs 1 credit per call. Use it to resolve a company to its numeric LinkedIn `id`, which linkedin_people_search (`company`) and linkedin_job_search (`companyId`) take for an exact company match. Look up by `linkedin_url` when you have it: a lookup by `name` returns the best match, which can be a different company with a similar name. The company is saved to `companies`.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn company URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme). Most reliable.

name.description: Company name (e.g. 'Acme Analytics'). Returns the best match; check the returned name and URL.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and fetch a fresh copy from LinkedIn (costs 1 credit). Default false: a previously-fetched result is returned free, with how long ago it was retrieved.

universal_name.description: The slug from the company URL (e.g. 'acme' for linkedin.com/company/acme).

name: linkedin_company_info
title: LinkedIn Company Info
